### CVE-2002-0229
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2002-05-03 | Updated: 2024-08-08 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 21264: PHP 4.x/5.x MySQL Library - 'Safe_mode' Filesystem Circumvention (1) (remote/php, 2002-02-03, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 21265: PHP 4.x/5.x MySQL Library - 'Safe_mode' Filesystem Circumvention (2) (remote/php, 2002-02-03, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 21266: PHP 4.x/5.x MySQL Library - 'Safe_mode' Filesystem Circumvention (3) (remote/php, 2002-02-03, verified=1)

Safe Mode feature (safe_mode) in PHP 3.0 through 4.1.0 allows attackers with access to the MySQL database to bypass Safe Mode access restrictions and read arbitrary files using "LOAD DATA INFILE LOCAL" SQL statements.
